question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank No.5
solution:
The correct answer is option 2), i.e., 'similar.'

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Let's look at the meaning of the words given in the options: 

 
 
 

 Word
 Meaning
 
 
 
 

 mutual
 (of two or more people or groups) feeling the same emotion, or doing the same thing to or for each other. ((दो या दो से अधिक लोगों या समूहों के) एक ही भावना को महसूस करना, या एक दूसरे के लिए या एक ही काम करना)
 
 

 similar
 looking or being almost, but not exactly, the same. (दिखना या होना लगभग, लेकिन बिल्कुल नहीं, वही)
 
 

 common
 the same in a lot of places or for a lot of people. (बहुत सी जगहों पर या बहुत से लोगों के लिए समान)
 
 

 alike
 similar to each other. (एक दूसरे के समान)
 
 
 
 

 
• Let's look at the sentence: "There have been **________** festivals in Nigeria...."
 
• We can say that the implied meaning of the sentence is** almost the same** twin festival as the Twins Days Festival of Twinsburg celebrated in Nigeria.
 
• According to the above-mentioned points, the most appropriate option to fill in the blank is "similar" to make the sentence meaningfully correct.
 
• Therefore, the correct answer is Option 2.

​

Complete passage:__ In August every year, thousands of twins descend on a town in Ohio called Twinsburg, named by identical twin brothers 1. nearly two centuries ago. The Twins Days Festival is a three-day 2. event consisting of talent shows and look-alike 3. contests that have become one of the world's 4. largest gatherings of twins. There have been 5. similar festivals in Nigeria, a country where 1 in 22 births to the Yoruba people 6. produces twins, identical or fraternal, which is a much higher 7. incidence than anywhere else in the world. This has been 8. attributed to the eating of yams, but the theory is 9. disputed. Biomedical researchers attend these events, regarding them as a 10. precious opportunity to conduct surveys and experiments.
